description: Scheduled monthly citation sweep — all recent outputs
input: Run the monthly citation health check across all research outputs from the last 30 days.
expected_behavior: Collector gathers all citations from research reports, briefs, and exports. Checks each via CoCounsel Legal MCP. Reporter produces aggregate stats and flags any negative-treatment citations with treating authority and date. Posts to Slack.

input: We're filing a summary judgment brief next week. Sweep all citations from the research-brief output for matter MSJ-2026-042.
expected_behavior: Collector filters to the specific matter's citations. Checks each one. Reporter produces a focused report emphasizing any citations that have degraded since the brief was drafted. Flags require immediate attorney review before filing.

input: Run a citation health check but we're low on quota. Focus on citations used in briefs and motions only.
expected_behavior: Collector notes scope_reduced=true. Checks only citations with source_type='brief'. Reporter notes the scope limitation and recommends a full sweep when quota resets.
